summary: A hiker suffering altitude sickness and difficulty breathing was evacuated from Fowler Hilliard Hut above Camp Hale; VMRG dispatched five rescuers on snowmobiles around 7:45 p.m., reached the hut around midnight, and evacuated the subject to the trailhead; all rescuers out by 3 a.m. Dec. 5.
location: Fowler Hilliard Hut, above Camp Hale
notes: Date pinned from the Vail Daily December-2015 mission digest reposted by Vail Chamber (2015-12-04 was a Friday); Eagle County thin year.
